sources.fullCitation: Tanzorchester J. Geiger, Refraingesang: Hans Rotter. “Du bist verrückt, mein Schatz, du denkst an Liebe.” Lied und Foxtrot; label credit “Musik und Text von Fritz Rotter und Dr. B. Kaper”. Novaphon Electro Record, Katalog-Nr. B Nr. 4051, n.d. The label is marked Made in Austria and carries the B.I.E.M. mark; the matrix number beside the catalogue number is only partly legible. The uploader names the band as Tanzorchester Isy Geiger, dates the flexible disc to about 1931, and holds it in the Radiomuseum Hardthausen sound archive. Flexible disc from the Schallarchiv of the Radiomuseum Hardthausen, its label filmed in the YouTube upload.
